title: Dimension of Disaster: Defender of Varrock
start: Talk to Reldo in the New Varrock Palace library.
prereq_quests: Dimension of Disaster: Coin of the Realm

items.t: Vial (not necessary if you already have a vial of red mist)
If unlocked, the New Varrock Zombie cosmetic override works in place of wearing the items (unlocked with silver pennies from Aris' reward shop from finishing the quest series).
To get the code (not necessary on replays as it will show when unlocking the door):

rewards.t: 15,000 Combat XP Combat XP lamp in one of the following skills: scl | Attack , scl | Strength , scl | Defence , scl | Constitution , scl | Ranged , scl | Magic or scl | Necromancy

Thieving XP lamp (Dimension of Disaster: Defender of Varrock)

steps.t: Speak to Reldo in the Castle library of New Varrock. [Chat: Accept › 5 Arrav?]
In the courtyard just east of you, talk to Arrav. [Chat: 1 Would you be willing to bring down Zemouregal?]
Tell Reldo what you learned from Arrav.
p: Arrav and Ellamaria in New Varrock Palace's garden.

steps.t: Search the northern-most bookshelf along the western wall for Heart magic notes.
Talk to Reldo again.

If not wearing the zombie override version, equip the full Zombie outfit (mask, shirt, trousers, gloves, and boots). This can be purchased from Thessalia's Fine Clothes. See Zemomark for ways to earn more currency.

sub.t: Replay: Full New Varrock Zombie outfit cosmetic override can be purchased from Aris' Reward shop with silver pennies (you must talk to Aris in the real Varrock. You must exit New Varrock to access her reward shop in Varrock Square in the southwest corner).

steps.t: Return to the New Varrock Castle. Enter the kitchen which is located on the floor 1 on the east side of the castle. You must enter the kitchen via the west door as a barrier prevents you from entering via the south door. Take 2 vials from the table.

sub.t: Replay: If you have saved red mist from a previous run, just head upstairs.

steps.t: Head upstairs via the south-east staircase of the castle and kill 2 armoured zombies - collecting the red mist that they emit upon dying by clicking on it with a vial in your inventory.

sub.t: Replay: If you have saved red mist, skip.

steps.t: Replay: Skip this step.
Go north and listen to Zemouregal over balcony.
On this same floor, enter the red barrier in the hallway to the centre balcony.
Head west, passing through 2 additional red barriers. You will be in a room with several coffins, a large wood table, and a tin soldier strapped to the table.
Inspect the tin soldier on the operating table in the south-western room.
Exit the castle by returning the way in which you entered.
Talk to the Trial Announcer at the east Varrock bank to get tin soldier head. [Chat: 3 Can I have a tin soldier head? › 1 I'd like to get ahead of competition. › 3 I have to go.]
Get three tin ores, four fire runes, and a nature rune. These can be purchased from Sani's ore shop south of the west bank and Aubury's rune shop south of the east bank.
Return to the tin soldier. Inspect him three times to activate him fully. [Chat: 1 Yes.], [Chat: 1 Go-go, roboto!], [Chat: 1 Yes.]

sub.t: Inspect the tin soldier one last time or just use a vial of red mist on the tin soldier if it has not automatically been applied.

steps.t: Replay: Skip this step if you have the decoder strips.

sub.t: If you don't have the decoder strips, go to the armoured zombie room on the east side of the floor 2 of the castle, take the strips from the crate, then go to the next section.

steps.t: Return to the far eastern room.
Search the crate in the armoured zombie room for some decoder strips.
Kill another armoured zombie if you need to refill empty vial with red mist.
Enter the red barrier to the far north-western room.

Scry the scrying pool in the north-eastern corner. Select [Chat: 1 New Varrock square › 2 Demon camp › 3 Graveyard › 4 Saradominist church › 5 Throne room balcony › 6 Garden of Hostility] (need to re-click on the scrying pool after each one) to unlock the medium New Varrock achievement Scrying Game and then [Chat: 7 Control the tin soldier] to continue the quest.
p: Using the Tin soldier to go past the human detection spell.
An example of the puzzle. The example code is 'EIHC', thus the final decoder strip must be placed on the C, revealing that the number is 2.

steps.t: As the tin soldier, enter the room north and search Zemouregal's lab desk for the code.
Unlock the treasure room safe (north-west corner of the north-west room) using the code you were given in the chatbox. Drag the red sliders over the numbers.
Enter the treasure room safe.
Smash the black prism.
Talk to Arrav twice.
Quest complete!
Pick up the watering can for the next sub-quest.

sub.t: Replay: Not needed if you saved purple mist.

get_inside.text: Varrock Teleport to Varrock Square. Run north.
Varrock lodestone to the southern city gate. Run north, through the city, through the square, to the castle.
Ring of Wealth, Ring of Fortune, Luck of the Dwarves, or Hazelmere's signet ring teleport to the Grand Exchange. Run northeast to the palace grounds, then south to the castle entrance.
